$comment: Single source of truth for plugin contribution points (contributes.<point>). Edit only this file, then run `pnpm --dir vue-app build:plugin-contracts` to refresh the plugin CLI (embedded), cloud, devkit and frontend copies and the devkit manifest schema. status 'enabled' means the desktop host, the `mincode plugin` CLI and the cloud accept the point; 'planned' points are rejected everywhere as unknown until their phase registers them. A point's keySinceHost.<key> (map points: a map key; list points: an optional entry field added after the point shipped, for example testProviders debugRun) and valueSinceHost.<list>.<value> (list points: a value of lists.<list> used in the entry field of the same name) and the top-level capabilitySinceHost.<capability> name the first host that accepts that addition (older hosts reject it); the plugin CLI and the cloud raise the package's minimum host to it.
